Label reference maps

Posible matches in selected pages

The listings below show the text of selected VMs pages, from the original file, showing possible references to selected labels.

The only labels considered in these listings is the "UNDER 100" class, those labels that occur less than 100 times in the whole parags file.

In these listings, the location of each text line is shown in angle brackets "<...>", in columns 1-19, as in the interlinear file (except that the anonymous location was renamed ".P", for "paragraph text"). Lines indented by two columns show labels, from drawings in other pages, that appear to match some part of the preceding text line. The location where the label is "defined" is shown in in curly braces "{...}". For example, the passage 

<f58r.P.28;F>      GSCAE.DAM.O8AEAEG.8AEAE.TG.2AIR.SODAR.OEAE8G.ODAEO8G-
  {f89v2.t.4}                                      TODARO
  {f72r2.S.2}                                          2AEAE
  {f88v.t.1}                                                    ODAEG8
  {f88v.t.1}                                                    ODOEG8
  {f70v2.S2.5}                                                  OHAEA7
  {f71v.S2.2}                                                   OHAEO8G
says that the label TODARO, defined in location {f89v2.t.4}, is a close match to the characters SODAR.O of line <f58r.P.28;F>. Also, the label 2AEAE, defined in {f72r2.S.2}, is a close match to R.OEAE on that same line. Finally, the labels ODAEG8, ODOEG8, OHAEA7, and OHAEO8G, defined where indicated, are all close matches to ODAEO8 of that line.
